beats.event: Born to Emperor Kiritsubo and a low-ranking, beloved consort
His mother dies when Genji is three years old
Emperor takes Fujitsubo as consort; she resembles Genji's late mother
Removed from succession, demoted to commoner with Minamoto surname
Forbidden love awakens for stepmother Lady Fujitsubo
Marries Aoi no Ue in a troubled, unfaithful union
Discovers ten-year-old Murasaki, Fujitsubo's niece, in Kitayama
Takes Murasaki into his palace and raises her as his ideal
Secret night with Fujitsubo; she conceives Reizei, paternity hidden
Aoi bears him a son but dies shortly after
Finds consolation and marries the grown Murasaki
Father Emperor Kiritsubo dies; court power shifts against him
Affair with Oborozukiyo exposed; exiled to Suma
Akashi affair fathers a daughter, his only child and future empress
Pardoned and recalled; his hidden son Reizei ascends the throne
Reizei, knowing the truth, raises Genji to the highest possible rank
At forty, his life begins to decline despite political height
Third Princess is assaulted by Kashiwagi and bears Kaoru
His beloved Murasaki dies, breaking him
Genji vanishes into the clouds (Kumogakure), his death implied
